constitution.history: 22 July 1954 - the Revised Organic Act of the Virgin Islands functions as a constitution for this US territory

courts.highest: Supreme Court of the Virgin Islands (consists of the chief justice and 2 associate justices)
courts.judges: justices appointed by the governor and confirmed by the Virgin Islands Senate; justices serve initial 10-year terms and upon reconfirmation, during the extent of good behavior; chief justice elected to position by peers for a 3-year term
courts.lower: Superior Court (Territorial Court renamed in 2004); US Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit (has appellate jurisdiction over the District Court of the Virgin Islands; it is a territorial court and is not associated with a US federal judicial district); District Court of the Virgin Islands
